entries.title: Desktop turn notifications stay on while game is open
changes: Desktop subscriptions now still receive turn notifications even if that player already has the game open.
Mobile and installed-PWA subscriptions keep the existing active-tab suppression behavior.
Master pushes now redeploy the notify Edge Function as well as resolve-automation.

entries.title: Fix fourth spaceship exploration reward
changes: In 4-player Lost Fleet games, the fourth exploration slot on a ship board now charges exactly 3 power instead of 4.
The Lost Fleet exploration tests and rules oracle were updated to lock in the 0/2/2/3 shuttle track.

entries.title: In-app update prompt for newer deploys
changes: Hosted tabs now detect when a newer version was deployed while they were open.
When that happens, the app shows a reload prompt so players can refresh into the latest build.
The release metadata is now published to /release.json as well as bundled into the hosted app.

entries.title: Release tracking and hosted lobby changelog
entries.impact: No player action required; this release only changes the hosted app UI and release workflow.
changes: The hosted lobby now shows the current app version and release date.
Players can open a dated changelog directly from the lobby to review recent updates.
Master pushes are now blocked unless the viewer version and hosted changelog were updated together.
Includes the Terraform ship-tech fix so its free mine prompt now fires before the tech-track bump.

entries.title: Baseline before hosted release notes
changes: Introduced lobby progress refresh improvements and Terraform ship-tech prompt ordering fixes.
